title: imap: SEARCH command handler (flag and header criteria)
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/search.rs. SEARCH evaluates criteria against all messages in selected mailbox. Algorithm: (1) require Selected state; (2) get all article numbers in group from ArticleNumberStore::group_range(); (3) for each article, evaluate SearchKey recursively: ALL -> always match; SEEN/UNSEEN -> check imap_flags; FLAGGED/UNFLAGGED -> check imap_flags; UID(set) -> check uid; SequenceSet -> check seq number; SUBJECT/FROM/TO/BODY/TEXT -> use OverviewStore query_by_range and string search; BEFORE/ON/SINCE(date) -> parse OverviewRecord.date and compare; LARGER/SMALLER(n) -> compare byte_count from overview; AND(keys) -> intersection; OR(a,b) -> union; NOT(k) -> complement; (4) send * SEARCH seq1 seq2 ...; (5) tagged OK. Limit: max OR/AND nesting depth 10; time limit 5s via tokio::time::timeout; on timeout send * SEARCH (empty) and tagged NO [INUSE].
